title: Catalog & Channel Readiness Matrix for New Model Releases
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Purpose: Consolidate a single cross-functional readiness matrix and channel playbook for adding a new LLM model to the public Redwood catalog. This ticket drives gating decisions for catalog publication, benchmark certification, docs readiness, and external announcements.

High-level acceptance criteria: 1) Model entry created in catalog with metadata and default runtimes; 2) Benchmark suite run with pass/fail on core perf and quality metrics; 3) Docs and SDK examples published; 4) Release notes drafted and approved; 5) Marketing/Sales announcement assets ready and embargo date set; 6) Legal and Security signoffs complete if required.

Checklist (owner initials and status inline):
- Product: Define catalog taxonomy entry and default tags (owner: PP) — Done 2026-02-20.
- Engineering: Model artifact ingestion + runtime compatibility test matrix (owner: ENG-4821) — In Progress, failing on half precision kernel for long-context workloads.
- Benchmarks: Run inference perf suite (latency P50/P95, throughput), quality evals (CoT prompts, hallucination spot checks) (owner: Ricardo Mendes) — Results in assets; baseline vs base-model attached.
- Docs: API samples, migration notes, breaking-changes checklist, quickstart notebook (owner: Mei Wong) — Draft ready, needs code sample revision for streaming API.
- Console: Catalog tile design & rollout flags for staged visibility (owner: DES-204) — Mockups approved; feature flag created.
- Release Notes: Draft human-readable summary + changelog entry + deprecation notes (owner: PP) — Draft v0.3 attached.
- Marketing: External announcement draft, blog outline, social copy, launch webinar plan (owner: Sasha Li) — High-level slots reserved; awaiting embargo date.
- Sales/CS: Battlecards, pricing guidance, migration FAQ (owner: Aaron Keller) — Initial draft; needs SLA implications clarified.
- Security/Legal: Export control review, KMS/HSM guidance, data processing statement (owner: Legal) — Security review required flagged.

Gating criteria (must pass all to publish to public catalog):
- Runtime compatibility: Model can serve on at least one hosted runtime (quantized and float) and on Dedicated with expected throughput (>100 tokens/sec at 512 context for 1x GPU).
- Benchmarks: P50 latency within 1.5x of target tier and quality metric (ROUGE/QA accuracy) not below baseline by >3%.
- Docs: Quickstart + example app runnable and verified by docs reviewer.
- Release notes: Legal-approved copy, security signoff, and embargo date scheduled for marketing.

Decisions & trade-offs recorded:
- We will ship with two variants: full-precision for accuracy-sensitive customers and 4-bit quantized for cost-conscious default. Trade-off: slightly higher hallucination risk in quantized path — mitigations include recommended prompt templates and an explicit quality badge. (Decision logged 2026-02-25).
- We will not enable automatic model fallback in the first two weeks of launch to avoid noisy regression signals in telemetry; manual routing will be used for Canary.

Rollback and fallback plan:
- If quality regressions exceed threshold in first 48 hours, we will route new requests to the prior catalog default model and pause new signups for that variant. ENG-4821 to implement emergency switch with <5min rollback SLA.

Release notes coordination schedule (key dates):
- Draft due: 2026-03-05 (complete)
- Legal/security review complete: 2026-03-09
- Final signoff (PM/Eng/Design/Docs): 2026-03-12
- Embargo lift / Announcement: 2026-03-22 09:00 PT

Announcement channels and owners:
- Blog post (long-form): Marketing (Sasha Li) — includes benchmark highlights and pricing table.
- Product changelog: PM (Priya Patel) — short technical summary + migration notes.
- Console banner & in-app tour: Design (Des-204) + Eng backlog ticket ENG-4982.
- Developer newsletter & partner emails: Growth (targeted lists).
- Social: Ops calendar and assets (Twitter/X, LinkedIn).

Quality monitoring & post-launch evals:
- Set up prompt-suite smoke tests tied to the eval dashboard (link in assets).
- Configure alerting on quality delta >2% and latency P95 >125% of baseline for 1h.
- Schedule post-launch retrospective and model health review on day 7 and day 30.

Artifacts and links: (add or update as tasks complete)
- Confluence: Model onboarding spec: https://company.atlassian.com/confluence/display/INF/Model+Onboarding+Spec+PM-32977
- Benchmarks dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/benchmarks/32977
- Draft release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
- Quickstart notebook: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/0AIXAMPLE12345
- Console mockups (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/Example/console-catalog-tiles

Open risks:
- Quantized path exhibits longer tail latency on 4096 context in specific kernels; Eng investigating fallback kernels (ENG-4821).
- Legal export control questions due to included tokenizer with third-party dependencies; Legal to advise by 2026-03-09.

Next steps (owners and dates):
- ENG-4821: Fix long-context kernel selection and add regression tests — owner: Sanjay Rao — ETA 2026-03-14.
- Docs: Update streaming example to use new SDK helper (PR #421) — owner: Mei Wong — ETA 2026-03-11 (in review).
- Marketing: Finalize embargo language and collect benchmark highlights — owner: Sasha Li — ETA 2026-03-12.
- PM: Schedule launch dry-run with cross-functional leads on 2026-03-15.

Notes for reviewers: Please check the "Gating criteria" section and confirm any additional legal/security controls required for public cataloging. If you see missing owners for any checklist item, flag immediately so we can assign before the dry-run.
